2610.12229.title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
2610.12229.paper_summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.
2610.12229.paper_summary_zh: 在文本引導的圖像編輯中，描述所需的變更通常是簡單明瞭的，但識別預期的物體或區域可能會很麻煩，特別是當幾個物體看起來相似時。<lb/>我們介紹了一個新的圖像編輯介面，讓用戶可以直接在圖像上放置空間標記和可選的簡短註釋。<lb/>這些註釋共同形成了一個畫布指令，指定了編輯的位置和變更的內容。<lb/>我們的編輯器 VibeEdit 根據這些指令執行物體的添加、移除、替換、屬性修改和移動，而不需要單獨的文本提示。<lb/>我們構建了 155 萬個源目標編輯對，包含物體掩膜和結構化的編輯描述，並在訓練過程中從中生成畫布指令。<lb/>我們對 Qwen-Image-Edit 進行了層解耦的條件調整，分別編碼源圖像和圖像編輯的畫布指令。<lb/>我們使用區域加權的監督微調訓練模型，隨後進行指標引導的強化學習，以提高編輯完成度、局部編輯質量和未編輯區域的保留。<lb/>我們在一個獨立構建的人類策劃基準上評估 VibeEdit，該基準包含 419 個案例，強調在相似物體之間的目標選擇。<lb/>VibeEdit 在我們的評估中達到了 79.9 的 VLM 指標分數和 32.8 dB 的外區域 PSNR，而 FireRed 的分數分別為 67.4 和 24.0 dB，是我們評估中得分最高的文本指導基準。
